title: Human Resource Recruiter
description:
Sourced and screened candidates based on client requirements. - Posted job openings on job portals and other recruitment platforms. - Conducted initial HR screening and coordinated interviews. - Followed up with candidates and clients throughout the recruitment process. - Managed candidate databases and maintained recruitment records. - Assisted in end-to-end recruitment activities.

Key Skills: Telecalling,Recruitment,Resource,Human resource management
